text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp—summer has finally arrived. 
The fate of an alternate universe where 
she retired before the Takarazuka Kinen. 
For now, that outcome has been 
successfully averted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there is no room for complete 
complacency. However, Neo Universe begins 
to speak of "hope" for the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To reconnect the bonds severed in another 
universe and spread them wide... A new 
dream begins here.
